name: getCase
description: Get the case record: claim details, status, flags, validation results, summary, assignment and recent timeline.

name: getDocuments
description: List the documents on a case with their IDs, type, confidence, extracted fields and a short text excerpt.

name: saveSummary
description: Save the structured case summary. Moves the case to SUMMARIZED.

facts.description: What happened and what is claimed, in 3-6 sentences

evidence.description: Evidence found, one item per document or fact

missingInformation.description: Every missing document or unresolved question

risks.description: Flags such as out of policy, possible duplicate, name or amount mismatch, suspicious document

nextAction.description: The single recommended next action for the adjuster
